confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough bounded estimates. Web sources for Mendoza were dated, aggregated, or inconsistent, and Argentine peso prices shift quickly with inflation, so the July 2026 figures are uncertain. Restaurant meal anchors are somewhat better supported than drinks. Cocktail and wine_glass are cross-checked against beer, because direct evidence was thin; the wine glass in particular rests on one anecdote and on general knowledge of restaurant markups in a wine region. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context, not checked against live listings. July is winter in Mendoza, which may push some hotel rates up, so these figures are less certain than the restaurant ones.
comparable_city_reasoning: Estimated as a mid-sized Argentine interior city with a strong wine-tourism trade, priced below Buenos Aires and well below Western European or North American cities. Food anchors use aggregated Mendoza and Argentina typical-price guides. Beer is the base for cocktail and wine_glass ratios. Accommodation uses general knowledge of Mendoza's lodging market, with no accommodation searches.
